cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our garden door opens into the broom cupboard. Wonderful, we can take a brush for the picnic crumbs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the attic. I'm carrying all the sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll take the sandwiches; grab the picnic blanket without climbing stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the cellar. The sandwiches are getting warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Built-in refrigeration. I'll put the sandwiches beside the wine.
